A separate event-controlled probe reproduced the lifecycle gap deterministically: block a header resolver before its config read, call service.shutdown(), drain config, then release the resolver; service.is_running was false and the config worker slot empty after drain, yet the released resolver created a live sase-config-token-refresh thread. shutdown drops the executor and active job while wait=False permits the resolver to continue. All probe workers were joined afterward. Authoring a medium tale for retained worker completion and producer-before-config cleanup, including bare/shared pilot apps and timeout/deadlock regressions. No implementation edits or bead closure yet; this is the requested planning handoff, not an exhausted coding attempt.
